description: agent-notes/design/Normalization.md specifies the comparison-time normalizer implemented in tether/normalize.py. The 'Pipeline (v1)' section enumerates the exact ordered steps (UTF-8/binary guard, BOM strip, CRLF/CR to LF, per-line trailing-whitespace strip, EOF-newline collapse, leading-tab expansion at tabstop 8) and the deliberate non-goals (no indent-width or internal-whitespace normalization). Adding/removing/reordering a step or changing the tabstop default in normalize.py must update the doc, and vice versa.
